book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu neing pekwi bange
Ka bouk limti la veil eno Yesu qou Petele me Jems me Yoan inyon Jems li, me qou xel venaxow me la lek lukendu vaxading ti.
Nanghei inyon eno moxo neing pekwi me wo bange wou xel mend. Me ma siing nambei sayeiv me e xe teimb wo pus ambei xeiyaing.
Dekakom Mose luw Eliya lam tyip wou xel mendghalus me di luk is Yesu.
Om Petele neil wou Yesu, “Tambiy Ngandoung, inye nimza bei xey a toumendei inye. Wangwei wa laleim devind nei, on tyek a sakev xomek nayak yayal, ti wou wang, de ti wou Mose de ti wou Eliya.”
Ka moxo di luk, laxap teltyip me lam wo tenu zeyi xel, me vya ti lam anghei laxap nei me neil, “Tine inye a neung, e tiwei a laleing vind o, a wo xeinglala en e. Om xam a mi ngo e!”
Xel betiyeing ngo tine me xel ev vaxend qatu eivek de mend la lek tembuing, is yalenyeing mouyo.
Ekom Yesu lam axlek lal. Moxo neil, “Qandi lek. Mal seng gwaleeng.”
Om lal veil mendlek, eno lal se yei xelti, qe Yesu venaxow.
Ka xel di lam axo veil lukendu, Yesu luk nikanzek wou xel bei, “Xam se neil wou xelti en vati wei xam ghe wei ne, qe ka Xomaxoneing Neu Moux qandi lek veil meyeing le.”
Xel betiyeing teling wou e, “Inye xel putoung wei petieing eno neil embei Eliya tyek nam a tax enva?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Xam ghe boulek neing bei Eliya e nam me menyex wou lulul dalus.

Ekom a neil wou xam bei, Eliya lam takwei nei, ekom xel se woulek e, qe xel wong kwa leimalei wou e teyei lek woueing nalei wei xel o. Eivek sakwaing kayon eno Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek na qou nimaying ngandoung lek xel memend.”
Woyom xel betiyeing woulek bei moxo di luk en Yoan Lipekeing.
Yesu wong yak ghavis wei laweeng nol dei eivek e yo wo nimza
Yesu is betiyeing yal on la wou xel qendu yon. Moux ti lam wou Yesu me ev vaxa qatu eivek wou e manghalus.
Moxo neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wa pyanaleim en a neung moux en mi puw vaxa mema me mindei eivek nimaying. Moxo mi pewilexe eivek nenyex, o mi teila eivek memiing.
A qou e me na lam wou wa xe xel betiyeing, ekom xel se teyei bei bong embo nimzalek.”

Yesu neil elox bei, “O xam moux alis vex wei se mi wongis eno xam xe woueing nalei me kwa eno se la teyei lek. Tyek a mendei is xam bouk vamva? Me teyei lek bouk vamva eno tyek a mi qalei nimaying wei xam o? Qou ghavis on me lam wou ay.”
Yesu neil laweeng nol on, dom e lam myayaing veil ghavis on, om ghavis on wo nimza lek seivma kayon bombek.
Woyom xel betiyeing venaxow lam wou Yesu me teling, “Nambei nya ekom xa se teyei bei tiy inyon na myayaing?”

Moxo neil elox bei, “Xam xe wongeingis on nayaka. A neil wou xam zonghek, wangwei xam xe wongeingis nayaka nambei mastet neughalus, wa teyei bei neil wou lukendu tine, ‘La veil inye me la inyei,’ on tyek na ngo me na. Lulti tyek se bo pok wou wang. [
Ekom lul ambei nye tyek se nam myayaing, qe nangya zeimeing me vambueing yaeing.”]
Yesu is e xe xel betiyeing la me qekuma nanghei Galili, woyom moxo neil wou xel, “Tyek xel a toung Xomaxoneing Neu Moux na eivek xomaxoneing memend.
Me tyek xel nyeis e mey, de lek bouk yal eno moxo tyek qandi lek mapieing.” Xel betiyeing ngo qayeeng tine om moxoyeiw laleind wo maying.
Da wei xomek vambuing o
Ka Yesu lis e xe xel betiyeing la tyip Kapenaom, xel wei mi qou takis wei xomek vambuing eno lam me teling wou Petele, “Beip xam xe putoung se mi toung takis wei xomek vambuing o?”

Moxo neil elox wou xel bei, “E, mi toung o.” Ka Petele lam eivek xomek eno Yesu luk ti myaxeeng me teling, “Simon, wang wou naleimim ambei nya? Xel king wei tembuing ne yo mi qou takis leimalei wou eti, wou xel venaxow neundyeiw, o wou xel amba?”
Petele neil, “Wou xel amba.” Yesu neil wou e, “Om xel venaxow neundyeiw se teyei bei toung takis.

Ekom xey se bong anghei xel laleind bo nol wou xe nei, om la lounyeing nei me nex wa xe ying la eivek. Woing tiwei wang qou tax o, wa tax e mya de tyek wangwei malew selewa ngandoung ti. Wa qou me ghe na bong wou xel en aning takis de wa nim is ambei nyon.”
